# gcxtras_sta_topic (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Genesys Cloud Speech and Text Analytics Topic by name and dialect.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcxtras_sta_topic" "example" {
  name    = "Agent Knowledge Gap"
  dialect = "en-GB"
  state   = "latest"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dialect` (String) The dialect of the topic (e.g. en-US, en-GB, de-DE). Required because multiple topics can share the same name across dialects.
- `name` (String) The name of the topic to look up.

### Optional

- `state` (String) Which version of the topic to retrieve. Valid values: `latest` (most recent version), `published` (only the published version). Defaults to `latest`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the topic.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `participants` (String) Which participants are analyzed (External, Internal, All).
- `phrases` (List of Object) List of phrases configured for this topic. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phrases))
- `program_ids` (List of String) List of program IDs this topic is associated with.
- `strictness` (String) The phrase strictness level.
- `tags` (List of String) List of tags associated with the topic.

<a id="nestedatt--phrases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phrases`

Read-Only:

- `strictness` (String)
- `text` (String)
